notes: The pressure was measured, not anticipated. 5.75.0 finished the model — four verticals, one canvas, every rail row opening a bound panel — and within a minute of driving it tile_panels refused: seven panels could not be laid out above their declared minimums in a 1660×1057 frame. That refusal was correct, and it was also the diagnosis. The answer to "too many panels" is not a denser grid. It is that a reader has several situations — the morning review, working a thesis, watching a book — and each wants its own canvas rather than a share of one.
